Source [S1] explicitly provides the formula $CoC_{eye} = A / (2d * res * tan(FoV/2))$ (noting the text representation in the prompt has a slight typo in variable placement compared to standard algebraic notation, but the source text clearly defines the relationship involving A, res, d, and FoV). The source confirms that this calculation is performed to ensure the holographic defocus blur matches the optical defocus blur of the human eye. It specifies the parameters used (A=1.5mm, etc.) and states the result is 15 pixels. All factual components of the claim (the context, the variables involved, and the specific result under the stated conditions) are present in the evidence.
